Label and all 16 sentences written by the Haiku 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Probes did not support the spelling-stem label: 'reaffirm' and 'reaffirmed' (0.36, 0.50) and 'affirms' (0.33) fired, but plain 'confirm' (0.13) did not, and 'confused' (0.01) stayed low, which argues against a 'conf' piece. The label is now about the affirm/reaffirm stem; 'confirm' is kept as a near miss to see whether it stays quiet.
